title: Update: Critical Mass Simulator now has 15 new levels, clearer goals, and you can build your own reactor autopilot
author: Existing_Bid9916
selftext:
I posted the free demo here 4 days ago. The main feedback I got (here and on other subs): it looks cool, but it’s not clear what you’re supposed to do. So most of this week went into that.

**Easier to understand**

* Level 2: the laser stays locked until the magnets are powered, so you can’t do the steps in the wrong order anymore
* Live warnings when something is going wrong (“too hot too fast”, “the core is blowing apart”), not just a fail screen at the end
* Turbines glow with the power they make, so you can see what’s working

**15 new levels in the full game (20 total)**

* **Stable Fusion:** build your own reactor autopilot with simple rules (IF core > X THEN open the valve), then let it run a whole night shift alone
* **Antimatter Era:** trap antiprotons with magnets, and anything they touch disappears
* **Gravitational Dance:** push neutron star fragments into orbit, survive the three-body problem

Same as before: Claude wrote the code, I designed and tested it. Every level is checked by bots, so it can be won and doing nothing never wins.

Free demo (levels 1–5): [https://r3dm00n.itch.io/critical-mass-simulator](https://r3dm00n.itch.io/critical-mass-simulator)  
Full game: \[link\] – $3.99  
Chrome or Edge with WebGPU.

If you got stuck last time, try Level 2 again and tell me if it makes sense now.

comments.author: thecrownforge
comments.body: The live warnings sound like a good fix for the 'what am I doing' problem. I would test level 2 with one new player and give no hints. Can they power the magnets first and explain why the laser unlocks? The bot test proves the level can be won, but it cannot tell you if the goal is clear to a person.
